title: Dissecting Hierarchical Reasoning Models: A Mechanistic Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.22197v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), a representative hierarchical Transformer-based latent reasoning model with many variants, on Sudoku, Maze, and ARC-AGI-2. We mechanistically understand how HRM reasons and what information it encodes. Our analyses compare HRM against Transformer baselines with and without recurrent modules, apply causal interventions on recurrent states, and utilize linear probes against random-direction ablations, as well as sparse autoencoders with feature ablations. Our results reveal several key findings: recurrent models outperform one-pass baselines, while single-state recurrent Transformers are comparable to HRM. State interventions further show that the causal contributions of the high- and low-level states vary across task-specific checkpoints and inference stages. Selected task variables are linearly decodable from the recurrent states in HRM, yet ablating probe directions produce effects comparable

translated_title: 解剖分层推理模型：一项机制研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了分层推理模型（HRM），这是一种具有代表性的基于分层Transformer的潜在推理模型，拥有众多变体，我们在数独、迷宫和ARC-AGI-2任务上对其进行研究。我们从机制层面理解HRM如何进行推理以及它编码了哪些信息。我们的分析将HRM与带或不带循环模块的Transformer基线进行比较，对循环状态施加因果干预，并利用线性探针进行随机方向消融，以及使用带特征消融的稀疏自编码器。我们的结果揭示了几个关键发现：循环模型优于单次前向基线，而单状态循环Transformer与HRM表现相当。状态干预进一步表明，高层和低层状态的因果贡献在不同的任务特定检查点和推理阶段有所变化。选定的任务变量可以从HRM的循环状态中线性解码，然而消融探针方向产生的效果相当。
tldr: 该研究通过机制分析揭示，分层推理模型（HRM）的分层双状态结构并非其性能优势的关键——单状态循环Transformer即可达到相当性能，且高层与低层状态的因果贡献随任务检查点和推理阶段而变化。
en_tdlr: This mechanistic study reveals that the hierarchical dual-state structure of HRM is not the key to its performance advantage—single-state recurrent Transformers achieve comparable performance, and the causal contributions of high- and low-level states vary across task checkpoints and inference stages.
